title: New hospital building, Brisbane: hospital plant
workplace: New 10 storey hospital building with a two level basement and rooftop helipad, on an existing hospital campus next to the live hospital, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Boilers and hot water plant
swms.task: Install and commission the steam boilers and calorifiers in the plant room, with the units lifted in by the crane company's mobile crane.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; the crane company's dogman slings and releases loads, and our licensed dogman receives and lands them with tag lines.

steps: Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts
Install and commission boilers and pressure vessels

swms.title: Standby generators
swms.task: Install the standby generators and connect their diesel fuel lines and day tanks in the generator room.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the diesel fuel are kept at the work area. Keep ignition sources away.

rules.phrase: standard or advanced boiler operation licence
